summary: MAIA Biotechnology, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 1.02 to report the termination of its At-the-Market (ATM) offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., effective seven business days after May 14, 2026. Since the March 2025 prospectus supplement, the company sold 3,116,012 shares for ~$5.68M gross proceeds. This is a routine termination of a securities sales agreement, not an acquisition, tender offer, or other special situation. The filing discloses no price, premium, or board recommendation. The termination appears ordinary and lacks the elements of a special-situation event.
